description: Delivery workflow gates: run preflight (tests, lint, typecheck, secrets, review routing) when Claude finishes a turn that edited files; scan commits for secrets; ask before pushes, tags, merges, releases and deploys. With an autonomy policy in .claude/delivery.json (v3), the approved steps (review, push feature branches, open PRs, turn on Auto-fix, risk-rated merges, clean up merged branches, continue the backlog) run without asking, and the hooks approve them outright so auto mode's classifier doesn't stop them either. v3.3: with "review": "session", each new PR gets a review session that shows engineering:code-review's tables, fixes, rates and merges or stops by risk; a turn that ran the review must show its tables. Skipped, with one notice at session start, when bun is missing.

hooks.command: command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bash_guard.ts"; [ -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ] && exec "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bash_guard.ts"; exit 0
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pr_opened.ts"; [ -x "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" ] && exec "$HOME/.bun/bin/bun" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pr_opened.ts"; exit 0
